BOARD_THICKNESS_MM.doc: Every bed box board — side panels, end panel, centre divider, rails — is 18 mm structural stock. Style 3 measures 18 throughout.

LENGTH_DEFAULT_MM.doc: Outer length of the bed box from the body's room face to the end panel's outer face when the params give none. Style 3: side panels 961 + end panel 18. Set by hand until mattress presets exist.

RAIL_HEIGHT_MM.doc: Height of every rail (long and short). One rail sits on the floor, one is flush with the top of the box.

RAIL_NOTCH_DEPTH_MM.doc: Depth of the notch in each short rail where the centre divider passes: cut from the top edge of the low rail, from the bottom edge of the high rail.

RAIL_NOTCH_CLEARANCE_MM.doc: The short-rail notch is the divider thickness plus this (18 + 2 = 20 wide).

DIVIDER_NOTCH_DEPTH_MM.doc: How far the centre divider's end notches run in from each end: the short rail's 18 plus 1 mm of room.

DIVIDER_NOTCH_UNDERCUT_MM.doc: The divider's end notch is the rail height minus this (100 − 15 = 85 high), so the half-lap with the 20 mm rail notch leaves 5 mm vertical clearance.

REAR_RAIL_GAP_MM.doc: The short rails at the body end stand this far clear of the body's room face (the boot's room-face upright).

END_PANEL_OVERSIZE_MM.doc: The end panel is cut this much wider than the box on each side — edge-banding / trimming allowance.
